data.name: Improved Intercept Blow
data.description: When the animal companion uses Intercept Blow to intercept an opponent's melee attack and succeeds, it can take all the damage from the intercepted attack, in which case its master takes no damage from the intercepted attack and doesn't suffer effects that trigger on a hit.

raw_tokens.value: Animal Companion Feat ~ Improved Intercept Blow

When the animal companion uses Intercept Blow to intercept an opponent's melee attack and succeeds, it can take all the damage from the intercepted attack, in which case its master takes no damage from the intercepted attack and doesn't suffer effects that trigger on a hit.
